note: Majority: Código de Familia (Decreto 76-84, La Gaceta 16 August 1984), as published by the Tribunal Superior de Cuentas' legal library (tsc.gob.hn) from the judiciary's documentation centre, art. 16 (as reformed by Decreto 35-2013): majority is reached at twenty-one; from eighteen one may marry with authorisation. The Constitution (1982, as reformed to 2004, same library), art. 36, makes citizens of Hondurans over eighteen, which is citizenship, not civil majority. The Civil Code itself was not found in that library. Whether a later reform (after 2013) changed art. 16 was not checked. Work: Código del Trabajo (Decreto 189-59) y sus reformas, as published by the Secretaría de Trabajo y Seguridad Social (trabajo.gob.hn, 2022 upload): art. 31 those who have turned sixteen have capacity to make an employment contract; art. 32 minors under fourteen, and those over it still in compulsory schooling, may not be employed in any work, though the labour authorities may authorise it where indispensable to the child's or family's subsistence; under sixteen at most six hours a day and 36 a week, by day; art. 33 those under sixteen need the written authorisation of their legal representatives (or a labour inspector). The form holds 14, the age below which no work is allowed save the subsistence exception; from 14 to 16 the parents' authorisation is needed, which the form doesn't hold. Performers: art. 129 forbids night work and overtime for those under sixteen and also their work in clubs, theatres, circuses, cafés and bars; so a performer under 14 (or under 16 in a theatre or circus) is barred; work in film or television isn't named. The form holds barred. The Código de la Niñez y de la Adolescencia was not read. Service: the Constitution (same library), art. 276: citizens from eighteen to thirty shall do military service voluntarily in peacetime; the State may call to arms under the Ley de Servicio Militar, and in an international war all Hondurans able to defend the country are soldiers. The form holds none.

sources.title: Código del Trabajo y sus reformas, Decreto 189-59 (Secretaría de Trabajo y Seguridad Social)
sources.said: Tienen capacidad para celebrar el contrato individual de trabajo las personas que hayan cumplido dieciséis (16) años de edad. Artículo 32 Los menores de catorce (14) años y los que habiendo cumplido esa edad, sigan sometidos a la enseñanza en virtud de la legislación nacional, no podrán ser ocupados en ninguna clase de trabajo. ... también se prohíbe el trabajo de los mismos en clubes, teatros, circos

sources.title: Código de Familia, Decreto 76-84 (Tribunal Superior de Cuentas, biblioteca legal)
sources.said: La mayoría de edad se obtiene al cumplirse los veintiún (21) años.

sources.title: Constitución de la República de Honduras, 1982, con las reformas hasta 2004 (Tribunal Superior de Cuentas, biblioteca legal)
sources.said: Los ciudadanos comprendidos en la edad de dieciocho (18) a treinta años (30) prestarán el servicio militar en forma voluntaria en tiempos de paz
